config_dir.description: Directory holding configuration files, SQLite database, and SSL certificates. Used for --configdir.

log_level.description: Logging level. Valid values: Debug, Info, Warning, Error. Corresponds to --loglevel.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to disable file logging. Corresponds to --logfile.

syslog.description: Enable logging to syslog instead of console/file. Corresponds to --syslog.

listen_address.description: Address(es) for client connections. Corresponds to --listen.

listen_port.description: Port for client connections. Set to 0 or empty to disable remote core mode. Corresponds to --port.

require_ssl.description: Require SSL for remote (non-loopback) client connections. Corresponds to --require-ssl.

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file. Overrides default configDir/quasselCert.pem. Corresponds to --ssl-cert.

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL key file. Only needed if not combined with the SSL certificate. Corresponds to --ssl-key.

ident_daemon.description: Enable internal ident daemon. Corresponds to --ident-daemon.

ident_listen.description: Address(es) for ident requests. Corresponds to --ident-listen.

ident_port.description: Port for ident requests. Corresponds to --ident-port.

db_backend.description: Selected database backend. Valid values: sqlite, postgresql. Corresponds to --select-backend or DB_BACKEND env var.

db_pgsql_hostname.description: PostgreSQL connection hostname. Corresponds to DB_PGSQL_HOSTNAME env var.

db_pgsql_port.description: PostgreSQL connection port. Corresponds to DB_PGSQL_PORT env var.

db_pgsql_database.description: PostgreSQL connection database name. Corresponds to DB_PGSQL_DATABASE env var.

db_pgsql_username.description: PostgreSQL connection username. Corresponds to DB_PGSQL_USERNAME env var.

db_pgsql_password.description: PostgreSQL connection password. Corresponds to DB_PGSQL_PASSWORD env var.

auth_ldap_hostname.description: LDAP connection hostname. Corresponds to AUTH_LDAP_HOSTNAME env var.

auth_ldap_port.description: LDAP connection port. Corresponds to AUTH_LDAP_PORT env var.

auth_ldap_base_dn.description: LDAP base DN. Corresponds to AUTH_LDAP_BASE_DN env var.

auth_ldap_bind_dn.description: LDAP bind DN. Corresponds to AUTH_LDAP_BIND_DN env var.

auth_ldap_bind_password.description: LDAP bind password. Corresponds to AUTH_LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD env var.

auth_ldap_filter.description: LDAP filter. Corresponds to AUTH_LDAP_FILTER env var.

auth_ldap_uid_attribute.description: LDAP UID attribute. Corresponds to AUTH_LDAP_UID_ATTRIBUTE env var.

auth_authenticator.description: Selected user authentication backend. Corresponds to AUTH_AUTHENTICATOR env var or --select-authenticator.
